title: Personal Checking: Maintenance Fee Waivers Reviewed on the Cycle Closing Date
content:
## When this review applies

Personal Checking provides a same-day review of a monthly maintenance fee whose date is the current business day, that day being the one on which the statement cycle closes; the owner starts it by questioning the fee. For such a fee, the tier's relationship waiver is judged on the relationship balance as it stands at close of business on that same date, and certain other waivers are judged alongside it. When a waiver judged in this review is met and the fee has not been refunded already, the fee was charged although a waiver was met; it is a bank error and is given back in full. Otherwise this review returns nothing, and the tier's remaining waivers or a request for goodwill are decided under the general Personal Checking maintenance fee and fee refund rules.

## Visible effect of a refund

The refund lands in the account activity immediately, is recorded as a bank-error correction of the monthly maintenance fee, and lifts the posted ledger balance by the refunded amount at once.

## Refund tool

`refund_same_day_maintenance_fee_e9518b99` is an agent tool held back until it is unlocked; once unlocked, the agent runs it. A run books one refund entry, dated today, refunding one monthly maintenance fee entry in full as a bank-error correction. It records whatever amount it receives against the fee it is pointed at and makes no check of that fee, its date, its amount or any earlier refund.

Parameters, one by one:

- `checking_account_id` — the checking account that bore the fee; its reference number comes from the checking account lookup.
- `customer_id` — who owns the account, given as the customer reference number that the profile lookup shows.
- `source_item_id` — the reference number of the monthly maintenance fee entry to be refunded, as the checking activity lookup lists it.
- `amount` — U.S. dollars to refund, always positive, written as a plain number with two decimal places after half-up rounding (for example 12.34).
- `statement_cycle` — `YYYY-MM` label of the statement cycle in which today's posting falls, that is, the month in which that cycle closes.

What comes back is a short confirmation: the reference of the refund just booked, the maintenance fee entry it relates to, the amount put back, and the posted ledger balance now standing — the two money figures expressed in USD to the cent. Once that confirmation is received, the refund is on the account.
